description: This is a build and test script for running rialto unit tests, including setup for coverage and valgrind analysis, with configuration for multiple test suites and paths.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command, exits on error unless error code is valgrindErrorCode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and orchestrate build and test execution.

methods.name: strOfKeys
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of suites to a comma-separated string of keys.

methods.name: getSuitesToRun
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of suites to run based on user input, defaults to all suites.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Configures and builds test executables using cmake and make.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the specified test suites, with options for listing, filtering, valgrind, and coverage.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs valgrind command arguments for a suite, with options for output redirection.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage report using lcov and genhtml.
